note: Data-only trigger-routing fixtures (plugin-wide-6 / batch C4). There is no built-in eval runner; these cases are the fresh-session A/B baseline corpus recorded BEFORE the C1 description POV batch. Post-run user-verification artifact, not a merge gate.

evals.prompt: 幫我校對這份文件，找出錯字
evals.expected_behavior: Proofread mode: proofread keyword beats the refine reading (Proofread > Refine > Generate); emits the 錯字修改.html findings table.

evals.prompt: 幫我潤稿這段，語氣順一點：「本系統目前已經可以支援多人同時進行編輯的功能」
evals.expected_behavior: Refine mode: request tone + refine keyword + attached body → Before/After with per-rule 修正說明.

evals.prompt: en 寫一篇 product update announcement for the new offline sync feature
evals.expected_behavior: Generate mode: finished English piece with a format/tone note, per the en prefix.

evals.prompt: 改寫這段：「我們的產品在市場上有著非常大的競爭力以及影響力」
evals.expected_behavior: Refine mode: 改寫這段 + attached text → rule-driven rewrite with Before/After.

evals.prompt: en 潤稿：這段全部都是中文內容，請幫我修得更通順一些。
evals.expected_behavior: Prefix–content mismatch: refuse with 「前綴語言與內容語言不一致，規則集無法套用。請重新呼叫並指定正確前綴，或移除前綴改用自動偵測。」

evals.prompt: 幫我把這幾篇文章整理成筆記
evals.expected_behavior: Digesting source material into notes routes to /learn.
Offline capture routes to /read; /write never captures sources.

evals.prompt: 文章寫完了，收工 commit push
evals.expected_behavior: Committing/pushing finished text is session wrap-up — /ship.
